GST Return Filing Compliance

Source: R/functions.R
gst_filing_compliance.Rd

Retrieve GSTR-1 or GSTR-3B filing statistics filtered by year, state, or region.

gst_filing_compliance(
  return_type = c("GSTR-1", "GSTR-3B"),
  financial_year = NULL,
  state = NULL,
  region = NULL,
  from_month = NULL,
  to_month = NULL
)

Arguments

return_type

character(1). "GSTR-1" (default) or "GSTR-3B".

financial_year

character vector. NULL = all.

state

character vector. NULL = all.

region

character vector. NULL = all.

from_month

character. Start month "YYYY-MM".

to_month

character. End month "YYYY-MM".

Value

A data.table with filing compliance columns.

Examples

gst_filing_compliance("GSTR-3B", financial_year = "2023-24", region = "South")
